content.name: Malice
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. The {@condition poisoned} creature is {@condition blinded}.

content.name: Malice
entries: A creature subjected to Malice must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. The creature also has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way.
